rules.matching: Compare an asset edge socket with the opposite edge socket of the neighbor.
rules.road: A road edge only attaches to another road edge.
rules.coast: A coast edge can attach to water, sand, or coast.
rules.land: Grass, dirt, sand, farm, park, and paved edges can sit next to each other.
rules.transparent: Sprite and overlay assets do not drive tile adjacency; place them on top of base tiles.
